# CET bids due by Nov 7, 2026

Six CET items fall due between today (Oct 8, 2026) and Nov 7, 2026. Three of them close today. Two more listed in the radar closed on Oct 6, 2026. All dates come from the radar as of Sep 24, 2026, so confirm each one on the owner's portal before acting.

## Due within 30 days

| Opportunity | Owner | Due | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Worcester Regional Airport 149A trade-contractor RFQ (electrical, fire alarm, renewables) | Massport | Oct 8, 2026 | Due today; M.G.L. 149A prequalification |
| BPS data-system generator and UPS | BPS | Oct 8, 2026 | Due today |
| Campbell Resource Center generator | Not specified | Oct 8, 2026 | Due today |
| New Bedford DCFC install | SRTA | Oct 9, 2026 | Run from the Taunton office |
| River Road pump station upgrades (CT) | Owner unconfirmed | Oct 15, 2026 | Horton CT team |
| Union Station generator replacement | WRA | Oct 28, 2026 | Worcester home turf |

(CET opportunity radar)

## Related, not a formal bid

- MassDOT NEVI developers' installer call (Global Montello / Applegreen memo). It is open until Oct 31, 2026. The radar also suggests offering Applegreen the same installer partnership for its 2026 Maine NEVI awards (CET opportunity radar).

## Recently closed or just outside

- **Closed Oct 6, 2026:** LRTA 250 kW generator and Glastonbury WPCF oxygen controllers.
- **Outside the window:** Cambridge neighborhood EV charging (federal-aid) is due Nov 10, 2026. The MassWildlife Roger Reed Hatchery generators and ATS are due Nov 25, 2026.
- **COMMBUYS feed:** None of the six items is due before June 30, 2027 (New England public bids).

## Coverage gaps

- The radar tracks 86 items, but only 3 item records were visible here. The top-actions list was also truncated. Other short-dated bids may exist, especially in CT (27 items) and ME (16 items).
- Automated access to COMMBUYS, CTsource/BizNet, RI Purchasing and NH DAS was blocked. Bids posted after Sep 24, 2026 may be missing.
- Bid values and due times are not in the context for these items. Pull them from each solicitation before go/no-go.

## Next actions

1. **Confirm today's submissions.** Check that the Massport 149A RFQ, the BPS generator/UPS bid and the Campbell generator bid were submitted. Note each closing time.
2. **Assign the next two owners.** Name an estimator for the SRTA DCFC bid (Oct 9) and confirm MassDOT prequalification and DBE status. Have Horton confirm the River Road owner and scope before Oct 15.
3. **Set a crew and response plan.** Build one crew plan for the WRA Union Station generator (Oct 28). Draft the NEVI installer reply before Oct 31.
4. **Re-run the radar.** Filter all 86 items on due dates through Nov 7, 2026, then manually check the blocked state portals for new postings.
